key.kinetrix_moves.dodge: Dodge (with A / D: aside, S / W: roll)
kinetrix_moves.settings.title: Kinetrix Moves: settings
kinetrix_moves.settings.style.clock.tip: Gold, like the vanilla clock. Shields stay steel grey.
kinetrix_moves.settings.style.medieval.t: Dark orange, like a medieval RPG. Shields stay steel grey.
kinetrix_moves.settings.sides.tip: Shields above armour on the left and energy above hunger on the right, or the other way round.
kinetrix_moves.settings.arrows.tip: Left of the hotbar while a bow is in hand: an arrow and how many you carry.
kinetrix_moves.settings.moves.tip: Which moves your keys make: dodges, rolls, lunges, strikes, the bow, the ledge.
kinetrix_moves.settings.moves.title: Kinetrix Moves: which moves are on
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.dodges.tip: R + A or R + D: a side step out of the way (with a sword or a bow it knocks an arrow aside).
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.rolls.tip: R + W or R + S: a roll forward or back.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.slide.tip: C while sprinting: a slide (C held: crawl on after it).
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.slideAttack: The left button while sliding with a sword or an axe: a half turn striking all around.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.vault.tip: R + W at point blank: a roll over the mob's back.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.kick.tip: W and Space down, R at a mob: the vault, a turn and a spinning kick.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.dive.tip: W and Space down, R with no mob near: a dive forward into a roll.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.dash.tip: S and the left button held with a sword, the right button once: a lunge forward with a crit.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.finisher.ti: The left button at point blank to a weakened mob: the finishing blow.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.guard.tip: The right button with a sword: the block, in time a parry.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.fallRoll.ti: R held while falling: the tuck and a roll on landing (less damage).
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.ledgeGrab.t: The right button in a jump, a fall or just past a drop's edge: one hand catches the ledge.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.autoHang.ti: Ctrl + W + C at a drop: turn round and lower yourself into the hang.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.ledgeHops.t: R while hanging: the hop mode, A or D held hops one after another.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.bowVolley.t: A full draw, then the left button: the volley.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.bowFlow.tip: After the volley, the right button held: the left button dodges, shoots, takes the next pose.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.legolas.tip: R at a full draw: shots with spins, one after another.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.kickCutscen: During the kick the camera goes behind you and the view narrows as if time slowed.
kinetrix_moves.ledge.no_room: No room to climb up there
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.fastRun.tip: Ctrl held while running: 7 blocks a second, eats 1% of the energy a second.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.rollKick.ti: Ctrl, W and Space down, R at a mob: a flip over it, a kick into its back, a roll.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.whirlwind.t: S and the left button held with an axe, then the right button held: three turns forward with the axe out. Let go to stop.
kinetrix_moves.settings.move.plunge.tip: Falling with a sword or an axe: the blade goes into the ground on landing, 20% less damage.
